name: Salzwedel (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Salzwedel (two red eagles and a key on white).
history: Municipal flag of Salzwedel; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Salzwedel arms — two eagles and a key on white
